note: Large files are private GitHub release assets. The full Qwen base is public and is not duplicated. All native checkpoints, selected camera models and latest recovery optimizer/RNG states are exported. Redundant historical camera optimizer checkpoints remain on the Modal volume; cloud-volume-index.json records them.

packages.name: safemetadrive-legacy-evidence.tar.gz
packages.description: Earlier camera/straight-road study recordings and simulator videos; distinct from SafeMetaDrive.

packages.name: safemetadrive-models.tar.gz
packages.description: Chosen camera adapters plus balanced-family comparisons, all exported native baseline checkpoints and skill checkpoints.

packages.name: safemetadrive-records.tar.gz
packages.description: All exported training histories, configs, logs, final episodes and development diagnostics; no weights.
